Use pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar simulation of flow past a cylinder.
Keep the mesh one cell thick in the spanwise direction.
Change the frontAndBack patch definition in constant/polyMesh/boundary to type empty.
Change the frontAndBack boundary condition in 0/U to type empty, with no value entry.
Remove the wall boundary condition from frontAndBack in 0/U.
Ensure the frontAndBack patch type is identical in constant/polyMesh/boundary and 0/U.
Leave the inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall boundary conditions set appropriately for a flow-past-cylinder case.
Do not use type wall for frontAndBack.
